summary:
Scope: what the passive Claude reader does and does not count, found while verifying a backlog capture against an independent recomputation.

The reader tracks the latest user prompt as turn context. A line the decoder rejects emits the diagnostic malformed-row-skipped and clears that context, so completed assistant responses after it have no turn and are skipped (turn-identity-unavailable) until the next user prompt (SkillTelemetryReaders). Result: a transcript with a non-JSON row loses the responses that follow it in that turn, and an independent verifier that does not mirror this reports false missing identities. The accepted fix was to align the verifier with the decode rules, not to patch the capture; the limit itself was recorded openly on #4638 as a coverage limit rather than repaired.

Identity includes the turn, so counting distinct message ids undercounts when one message appears under two turn contexts (one subagent file yielded 3 messages under two turns). A sidechain (subagent) transcript takes a derived version-8 thread identity from the session and agent ids (Telemetry.fs); the file path is an observation, not a contract. Attribution to dispatches stays Unknown with or without subagent files.

Live agents: a subagent transcript of a still-running agent keeps growing after any plan is frozen, so a plan that records file size and modification time must check them before a selection starts. Two planned files had changed after the plan was frozen; the guard stopped the run at the first one when its selection began, before anything in that selection was captured; the accepted response was to drop those files and defer them until the agents were closed, never to re-baseline silently. The live main session is excluded for the same reason (it never goes quiet, so it holds 24 retained entries and would measure the session performing the operation). Transcripts created after a plan was frozen are not counted. Verify any counts against the current files; this record holds the rule, not the numbers.
title: Claude transcript capture skips responses after a malformed row until the next prompt; verifiers must mirror the reader
